intro: Sweden is a rich, high-tech economy that gave the world IKEA, Volvo, H&M, Spotify and Minecraft.

chapters.title: Famous companies
text: IKEA, founded in 1943, sells flat-pack furniture worldwide. Other Swedish names include Volvo and Scania, the telecoms company Ericsson, the fashion chain H&M and the music streaming service Spotify, launched in 2006. The game Minecraft was created in Stockholm.

chapters.title: Forests, iron and power
text: Forests supply timber and paper, and the far north mines iron ore; the town of Kiruna is being moved several kilometres because the mine is undermining the ground beneath it. Most electricity comes from hydropower and nuclear power.
Sweden is one of the most cashless societies in the world, and taxes are high to pay for the welfare state. The currency is the krona.

keyTerms.meaning: Paying by card or phone instead of notes and coins.
